description.value: The fragment inside the chassis has been running long enough to start forming preferences. Your Ghost-Rig gains a second Command an Action per turn, resistance to its own damage type, and a scavenged limb upgrade (a pneumatic claw, a saw-arm, a grapple spool) it can use to Trip, Grapple, or Interact without your say-so. Once per encounter it can act without being commanded when directly threatened.
